GitHub hər faylın neçə dəfə yükləndiyini.en: GitHub counts every download of each file: from the site, from direct links and from app and agent updates. Test downloads are included too, so the number is higher than the site's own counter.

The server package is served by the Fixit central server (id.fixit.az): the link goes through the site and every download is recorded in the request.
